description: Use this when someone running a business gives their fixed costs for a period (rent, wages, power for a month), what one item costs them and what they sell it for, and asks how many they must sell to cover their costs (break even). Do not use it for a business plan's forecasts or to judge whether a business will succeed.

cost_per_item.description: What one item costs to buy or make.

currency.description: The currency, as its three-letter code (GHS, NGN, KES, ZAR...). Only labels the answer; leave out if unknown.

fixed_costs.description: Costs that do not change with how much is sold, for the period (for example a month's rent, wages and power).

period.description: The period the fixed costs are for. Leave out for a month.

sale_per_item.description: What one item is sold for.

name: business.break_even
title: Sales needed to cover fixed costs
